scope: Exploratory MuJoCo LIBERO deadline replication for one attested pi0.5 checkpoint

decision_rule_after_seed8_endpoints.order_note: Seed 9 endpoint cells run 175 -> 155 -> 150 to counterbalance the earlier 150 -> 175 order.

analysis_plan.reporting: descriptive per-seed tables with Wilson intervals and paired episode discordance
analysis_plan.paired_unit: task_id plus episode_index within a fixed task suite
analysis_plan.pooling: do not pool cells into an iid population estimate or universal threshold
analysis_plan.interpretation: treat 150-to-175 behavior as a service/task-specific clock-quantization transition unless reproduced across the registered cells
analysis_plan.multiple_comparisons: no post-hoc threshold search beyond the registered 155 ms boundary probe

stop_conditions: provider failure, missing inference/simulation overlap, worker not stopped, or validator invalid
checkpoint attestation, OpenPI commit, or runtime source hashes differ from the fixed protocol
less than 60 minutes of server lease remains before starting another cell
do not launch a new cell solely because an intermediate success rate looks favorable
claim_boundaries: not an official LIBERO leaderboard score
not hardware safety or real-robot deployment evidence
not cross-model superiority or a universal VLA deadline threshold
